scores.evidence: Phase 2 "Depends on: Phase 1, V2, V3"; Phase 3 "Depends on: Phase 2, V1, V5"; Phase 4 "Depends on: Phase 3, V4, V5, V6"
scores.rationale: Phases run substrate → defenses → features → model → enforcement → feedback, each gated by prior validation, with an explicit dependency map.

scores.evidence: a small real purchase on an allow-listed staff test card... auth host sends the incumbent's normal response... writes it to its audit record
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real production end-to-end slice with deploy, trace, alert and rollback, verified by V0.

scores.evidence: Decision | Reversibility | Default (chosen now) | Assumption | Validated by | Flip condition
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are tabulated with defaults, assumptions and concrete flip conditions, and unknowns are labeled.

scores.evidence: Enforce in this order: staff cohort, then 1% of tokens in one segment, then 5%, 25%, 100%.
scores.rationale: Shared substrate and boundary work (PAN controls, tap on all nodes, fallback and breaker) precede leaf work, and widening is staged by exposure, though blast-radius ordering within phases is only partly explicit.

scores.evidence: Token-only payload; mTLS; Vault for secrets; cardholder-data network segment; flag off by default
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security treatment in every phase from 0 to 6.

scores.evidence: One OpenTelemetry trace per auth message ID; timeout alert; logs classified as cardholder data
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in each later phase.

scores.evidence: Terraform, Argo CD, signed and pinned images; versions recorded in every decision
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is concrete in every phase, covering infrastructure, replay corpora, backfill pinned to offsets, and lineage.
Failure handling is specified in every phase from Phase 0, and V4 and V5 exercise it with fault injection.

scores.evidence: Guardrail defense... Phase 2; Human-in-the-loop... Phase 2 (change control), Phase 5 (queue); Retrieval Phase 3; Model access Phase 4
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets and human controls precede retrieval, model, orchestration and feedback. Memory ordering is a documented exception (E1), and routing is explicitly deferred.

scores.evidence: Retiring the incumbent (point of no return). Pull forward when the new path has run at 100% for ≥ 2 quarters
scores.rationale: Each deferred item has a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: A very strong plan on all ten dimensions. Its one small gap is that human-in-the-loop for enforcement only lands in Phase 5, but it is documented and gated.
